name: Cloying Shadows
body:
School illusion (shadow) [darkness]; Level bard 2, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be further than 25 ft. apart.

Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With a gesture you cause nearby shadows to wrap and twist around your target’s eyes. Any creature that fails its Will save can see only 5 feet and its vision is clouded as the darkness spell, granting creatures within 5 ft. of the target partial concealment.
